decisions.name: Bayshore Inn
basis: Current first-party Bayshore material describes a small casino/bar with 15 video-poker machines.

Fifteen machines falls below Nevada's 16+ slot threshold that can independently support nonrestricted status, and the property presents primarily as an extended-stay inn rather than a destination casino.
Dinner Roulette's curated casino backbone therefore excludes this small lodging/bar gaming operation; live discovery can remain supplemental.

decisions.name: Alamo Casino Sparks Petro
basis: Current first-party Alamo material identifies a dedicated casino at Sparks Petro with 151 slot machines, full-service bar, sportsbook and player club.
This is materially larger and more casino-specific than ordinary restricted retail/route gaming and meets Dinner Roulette's physical-destination scope.

decisions.name: Red Drag Casino
basis: The current 2025-2026 Explore Elko visitor guide lists Red Drag Casino at 404 S 5th St among Elko casinos and gaming destinations.
Final runtime inclusion still requires active NGCB location identity and coordinate QA.

decisions.name: Eureka Casino
basis: Current first-party Eureka Casino material identifies Eureka Casino at 595 E Sahara Ave in Las Vegas and Eureka Casino Resort at 275 Mesa Blvd in Mesquite.
No current evidence establishes a corresponding Eureka Casino destination in the town of Eureka, Nevada.
The staged rural row is treated as a name/location conflation rather than a physical destination.

decisions.name: Gold Dust West Winnemucca
basis: Current Gold Dust West first-party properties are Reno, Carson City and Elko.
Regulatory/first-party searches did not establish a Gold Dust West casino in Winnemucca.
The Winnemucca candidate is therefore an erroneous location assignment and must not be activated.

ruralAddressQa.name: Tonopah Station Hotel & Casino
ruralAddressQa.address: 1137 S Main St / 1137 Erie St, Tonopah, NV 89049
ruralAddressQa.note: Town and first-party use Main/Erie naming for the same highway corridor; normalize final geocoded street label during coordinate QA.

notes: This pass resolves the four named scope-review items carried forward from ambiguity pass 3 and also corrects the staged Gold Dust West Winnemucca error.
Red Drag remains a candidate rather than a final runtime include until NGCB matching is complete.
Coordinate QA remains a separate gate.
